# Nihontabi
> Thai-language Japan trip planner. Stay in one hub city and make day trips all year round. Covers 6 hubs (Tokyo/Ueno, Osaka/Namba, Sendai, Nagoya, Fukuoka/Hakata, Sapporo) with routes, fares, passes, best months and estimated flight prices from Bangkok.

Facts are compiled from official sites and travel sites (data as of 2026-11-18); prices and hours change, so verify with the provider before travel. Flight prices are sampled estimates, not live fares.

## Guides
- [โตเกียว (ฐาน Ueno)](https://nihontabi.web.app/guide/tokyo/): 26 places reachable as day trips, routes, fares, best months
- [โอซาก้า (ฐาน Namba)](https://nihontabi.web.app/guide/osaka/): 114 places reachable as day trips, routes, fares, best months
- [เซนได (ฐาน Sendai Station)](https://nihontabi.web.app/guide/sendai/): 107 places reachable as day trips, routes, fares, best months
- [นาโกย่า (ฐาน Nagoya Station)](https://nihontabi.web.app/guide/nagoya/): 96 places reachable as day trips, routes, fares, best months
- [ฟุกุโอกะ (ฐาน Hakata)](https://nihontabi.web.app/guide/fukuoka/): 108 places reachable as day trips, routes, fares, best months
- [ซัปโปโร (ฐาน Sapporo Station)](https://nihontabi.web.app/guide/sapporo/): 103 places reachable as day trips, routes, fares, best months
- [Month guides](https://nihontabi.web.app/guide/month/jan.html): best places by month (jan..dec)
- [Theme guides](https://nihontabi.web.app/guide/theme/food.html): places by theme (food, onsen, snow, sakura, anime, ...)
- [Pass guides](https://nihontabi.web.app/guide/pass/): 83 active travel passes with prices, validity, exclusions, where to buy
- [Guide index](https://nihontabi.web.app/guide/)

## App
- [Interactive planner](https://nihontabi.web.app/): choose month, trip length (3-15 days) and passes; plans and maps. Thai UI.
